subject.title: feat(dreaming): add language config option for localized dream diaries

question: Should Dream Diary localization be accepted as a supported `memory-core` configuration contract, and if so, should it be a single language hint or a broader prompt-customization surface?
rationale: The branch introduces a new user-facing plugin configuration API; choosing its permanent scope and compatibility contract requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Keep the language-hint scope
options.body: Sponsor a fresh PR that keeps one documented top-level language hint, removes unsupported execution-level variants, and proves the actual narrative write path.

options.title: Design broader prompt customization
options.body: Keep the tracker open while maintainers define whether a supported prompt override belongs alongside or instead of a locale hint.

recommendation.title: Keep the language-hint scope
recommendation.body: Sponsor a fresh PR that keeps one documented top-level language hint, removes unsupported execution-level variants, and proves the actual narrative write path.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly requested this reviewer’s product and implementation feedback, though repository-history ownership confidence is low.
